csv_agency: National Park Service - Department of Interior
csv_scope_of_work: This project will relocate the Bullfrog Launch Ramp to the vicinity of Stanton Creek. The existing marina and launch ramp are no longer viable due to receding water levels, and the tributary is expected to remain dry under future low-water conditions. The proposed project relocates the ramp to the main channel of the Colorado River to ensure long-term functionality. Associated utility and infrastructure improvements (roadway and parking area) will also be required to support the relocated facilities. The following summarizes the preliminary concept currently under development for the RFP
